bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. The window verdict is computed from launched unit identities in a timeline; it says nothing about whether the questions asked were the RIGHT ones, only whether they were different ones.
identity_rule: causal_question_id derives from objective, hypothesis family, discriminator and evidence changed - never a prompt hash. health_probe.007 and .008 are ONE question asked twice.

invariants.NO_LOW_INFORMATION_BUSY_LOOP: the missing complement. The resident must stay busy on useful UNCERTAINTY, not merely busy.

health_probes.policy: the first probe in a window is free; every repeat needs changed state, an elapsed risk interval, a new mutation or an observed anomaly. Cheap and safe is not a reason to run something again.

window.bar: a family may hold at most 50% of a window and a window needs at least 3 distinct causal questions. Launches per hour is not the metric.
why: WU.HAWKING.health_probe is 44 of 51 launches (86%), over the 50% bar
